</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="1183.0" y="749" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="1183.0" dy="0">Current T3; memoryM4; K7; two heads width8; external relative encodings and separate biases.</tspan>
<tspan x="1183.0" dy="16.52">Content score AC and shifted relative score BD are separate source branches.</tspan>
<tspan x="1183.0" dy="16.52">Caller memory is consumed; output contains current positions only; no memory update is drawn.</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="1183.0" y="823" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="1183.0" dy="0">Reviewed static source + selected profile. Repeated groups are templates; shapes are not runtime observations.</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="1183.0" y="853" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="1183.0" dy="0">E### = source span; dashed = side / shape dependencies; fork/join roles are typed in IR; no implicit sum.</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="1183.0" y="878" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="1183.0" dy="0">Repeated colors encode operation roles. Shared weights and independent instances are recorded in semantic_ir.json.</tspan>
</text>
